compendium.summary: Long-duration service requiring setup, cost and a valid target.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Component planning: Downtime service loop. Only worth it if creature access and setup are real.
Pre-cast gate: Keep an eligible creature present through the casting and write commands that can actually be followed.
Failure state: Containment fails, the save succeeds, duration assumptions are wrong, or commands backfire.
Safe operating default: Use negotiated service when possible; confirm the exact summon/binding interaction.
